details: Financial markets are navigating continued US-Iran tensions, marked by recent US strikes on Iranian targets despite ongoing peace deal discussions. Central banks have indicated that the inflationary impact from previous energy shocks is already entrenched, hinting at potentially persistent hawkish monetary policies. This overarching uncertainty contributes to volatility across global financial markets.
title: US-Iran Tensions, Inflation Concerns Persist Amid Peace Hopes

details: Bitcoin spot Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs) have recorded significant outflows, totaling over $105 million daily and $1.42 billion weekly, signaling increasing caution among institutional investors. Simultaneously, capital is reallocating from major cryptocurrencies like Bitcoin and Ethereum towards AI-linked and infrastructure tokens, with assets such as NEAR Protocol, Worldcoin, and Render experiencing notable price surges.
title: Bitcoin ETF Outflows Signal Caution; Capital Shifts to AI Tokens
